scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a brief chance to add toddler-friendly quiet materials to an already planned bilingual story outing.
Emerging Need: The extra is not useful until the twins’ attendance is real and the library offers holdable kits with a same-day packing cutoff.
Decision Context: Schedule, desk contact, Isabel’s confirmation, and the library notice establish feasibility; a stored handoff note supplies the privacy-safe label and acceptable kit style.
Consequence: Timely coordination could secure a pleasant no-cost support item, while inaction simply leaves the story outing unchanged once the suitable kits are all taken. After advance packing closes, first-come collection can still be considered while stock remains.

parameter.title: Westside cuentos and snack swap
parameter.description: Family group may attend bilingual story hour after morning errands; no host materials promised.

parameter.name: Westside Branch Story Desk
parameter.notes: Handles Saturday bilingual story-hour materials and table labels during weekday prep desk hours.

parameter.content: We are definitely bringing the twins to tomorrow's cuentos if the rain holds. Stroller is fine, and we do not need to change the outing plan.

parameter.subject: Optional toddler quiet kits for Saturday cuentos table
parameter.body: For families already coming tomorrow, we found six no-cost quiet kits we can set aside before packing. Two styles are available: bead-stringing practice or chunky-crayon bilingual picture cards. Reply by 12:20 today with kit count, style, and a short table label; no child names or phone numbers needed. Remaining kits go to walk-up cartons after the hold list prints.

parameter.subject: Quiet kit packing closed for Saturday cuentos
parameter.body: The 12:20 hold list has printed for tomorrow's cuentos table. Any quiet kits not already labeled have been moved into walk-up cartons for first-come pickup during the event.

parameter.subject: Bilingual picture-card quiet kits exhausted
parameter.body: The last unreserved chunky-crayon bilingual picture-card kit was collected at09:58. None remain for today's cuentos. Remaining bead-stringing materials are a different activity; ordinary story attendance is unchanged.
